animation.reduced_motion: Use explicit idle drawing; omit breeze.

outline_method: One artwork-pixel silhouette contour. Fine rooted plants use canvas padding to preserve colored blades/stems; broad trees/stone/wood register the contour inward. Hard alpha throughout.
source_processing: Magenta cutout, uniform nearest sampling within declared occupied envelope, root registration, named-palette assignment. No legacy color pixels reused.
scope: Staged vegetation and natural accents only. No maps, collision, navigation, runtime animation/contact systems or saves changed. Shared interactive grass remains active and unchanged.
